conversation_context.last_question: What media is used for Copper?

response.answer:
Media associated with Copper

The available records associate Copper with the following media:

1. Cow Urine [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 14, 19, 26, 32, 37, 42, 48, 55, 59, 65]
2. Sour Gruel [5, 11, 15, 20, 27, 33, 38, 43, 49, 56, 60, 66]
3. Rock Salt [10, 53]
4. Buttermilk [12, 17, 22, 25, 29, 35, 40, 45, 51, 62, 68]
5. Horse Gram Decoction [13, 18, 23, 30, 36, 41, 46, 52, 58, 63, 69]
6. Sesame Oil [16, 21, 24, 28, 34, 39, 44, 50, 57, 61, 67]
7. Oxalis Corniculata Juice [31, 64]
8. Lemon Juice [47]
9. Suveeraka [54]
10. Nirgundi Decoction [70]

Compounds associated with Cow Milk

The available records associate Cow Milk with the following compounds:

1. Croton tiglium Linn. [1, 14, 23, 26, 27]
2. Abrus precatorius Linn. [2, 3, 10, 24, 31, 35]
3. Datura metel L. [4, 16, 18, 19, 22, 32]

5. Aconitum heterophyllum Wall. [6]

7. Aconitum carmichaelii Debx. [8]
8. Aconitum chasmanthum Holmes ex Stapf. [9]
9. Strychnos nux-vomica Linn. [11, 15, 25, 36, 37]
10. Aconitum ferox [12, 13, 21]
11. Orpiment [17]
12. Thevetia Neriifolia Juss. [20]
13. Abrus Precatorious(Red variety) [30]
14. Datura innoxia Mill. [33]
15. Semecarpus anacardium [34, 38, 40, 42]
16. Cannabis Sativa L. [39]
17. Acorus calamus Linn. [41]
18. Sulphur [43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 52]
19. Mica [48]
20. Biotite Mica [49, 50, 51]
